blocking_methods.label: toll-free-india
blocking_methods.instructions: From India call the GCAS India toll-free access number 000-117, then 866-765-9644. From the US call 1-866-765-9644. Anywhere else, call collect +1-303-967-1096. 24x7: agents report lost/stolen cards to the issuer (blocked in ~30 min) and arrange emergency card replacement and cash.
